question_text: A study is designed to assess the functions of immune components. The investigator obtains a lymph node biopsy from a healthy subject and observes it under a microscope. A photomicrograph of the cross-section of this lymph node is shown. Which of the following immunologic processes most likely occurs in the region labeled with an arrow?

Question: A study is designed to assess the functions of immune components. The investigator obtains a lymph node biopsy from a healthy subject and observes it under a microscope. A photomicrograph of the cross-section of this lymph node is shown. Which of the following immunologic processes most likely occurs in the region labeled with an arrow?

Options:
opa. T cell activation
opb. Macrophage activation
opc. Negative selection
opd. V(D)J recombination
ope. Isotype switching
